item.title: Syla Swords, Olivia Olson lead No. 8 Michigan past Oregon 80-58 in Big Ten quarterfinals
item.description: Syla Swords scored 17 points and Olivia Olson had 16 as No. 8 Michigan beat Oregon 80-58 in the Big Ten Tournament quarterfinals.

item.title: Women in South Africa take up guns and martial arts for protection against gender violence
item.description: Women in South Africa are turning to guns and martial arts for self-defense in a country where rates of gender-based violence are extremely high.

item.title: NHL-worst Canucks beat the Blackhawks 6-3 to end a 7-game skid
item.description: Brock Boeser batted the puck in to break a tie at 2:40 of the third period and the NHL-worst Vancouver Canucks beat the Chicago Blackhawks 6-3 on Friday night to end a seven-game losing streak that started in January.

item.title: NHL-leading Avalanche win 5-4 in shootout to end Stars' franchise-record 10-game winning streak
item.description: Valeri Nichushkin scored with 15 seconds remaining in regulation, then made one of NHL-leading Colorado's two shots in a shootout to beat Dallas 5-4.

item.title: Floral Park boys basketball's Brendan Martin propels Knights to second straight Nassau Class AA title
item.description: The boys basketball team's season ended in the ensuing Long Island championship game last season, though. They look to advance beyond that this winter.

item.title: St. John's secures No. 1 seed in Big East Tournament by beating Seton Hall
item.description: St. John's earned at least a share of the regular-season title for a second straight season — the first time that's happened since 1984-85 and 1985-86.

item.title: Ejiofor powers No. 18 St. John's past Seton Hall 72-65 for at least a share of the Big East title
item.description: St. John's beat Seton Hall 72-65 and clinched at least a share of a second straight Big East regular-season title.

item.title: Colorado women send No. 20 Baylor home with 62-53 victory in Big 12 quarterfinals
item.description: Desiree Wooten had 21 points, Zyanna Walker scored 19 and Colorado upset No. 20 Baylor 62-53 in the quarterfinals of the Big 12 Conference Tournament.

item.title: Alabama man facing execution for deadly robbery asks for clemency as he didn't kill victim
item.description: Charles "Sonny" Burton is scheduled to be executed March 12 for his role in a 1991 robbery in which a man was fatally shot.

item.title: East-leading Hurricanes beat the Oilers 6-3 for their 7th victory in 8 games
item.description: Jackson Blake scored twice, K'Andre Miller had three assists and the Eastern Conference-leading Carolina Hurricanes beat the Edmonton Oilers 6-3 on Friday night for their seventh victory in eight games.
